summary: OrientationEditAll is an ASP.NET user control for editing multiple student orientation records in bulk within an enrollment management context, specifically for HSPnet. It manages both data entry and editing, including UI behaviors, validations, saving/updating workflows, and system responses across a grid of student orientation rows.
purpose: To provide a bulk-edit interface for student orientation records, allowing authorized users to add, modify, and save orientation details for multiple students, with built-in validation, workflow control, and different modes for read-only and editable states.

workflows.name: Bulk Orientation Edit/Save
steps: User edits fields: Agency, Site, ContentSource, OnsiteLocation, OrientationDate, Comments, Description.
System tracks dirty state per row via txtDirty.
On Save (cmdSaveAll/cmdSaveEditNext), for each dirty row:
If OrientationID = 0 and Agency is present: controller.Add is invoked to create new record.
If OrientationID > 0: controller.Update is invoked to update record.
System checks for user messages/errors and may redirect based on result.
On SaveEditNext: Redirects to next set of records with adjusted query parameters.
On Save: Only first row is processed for add/update.
On Cancel/SaveAll: Redirects to Enrollment.aspx with relevant filters.

workflows.name: UI and Controls Setup
steps: Set up JavaScript variable declarations for client field state and validation messages.
Disable edit fields if blnReadOnly is true.
Hide or show various header/footer panels and buttons based on EnrollmentID and row count.
Set up onKeyUp JavaScript event for txtComments to enforce max length.
Hide txtContentSource and txtOnsiteLocation fields depending on ProviderTypeCode.
Bind data to GridView and manage visibility of Save/Cancel buttons.

workflows.name: Data Source and Parameterization
steps: dsMaster_Selecting wires up ObjectDataSource input parameters from control properties and UserSession.
Cancel data load if UserSession is null.

business_rules: Only dirty rows (txtDirty=true) are processed for save/update.
Agency field must not be empty for new records.
Read-only mode disables calendar controls and field editing.
ProviderTypeCode controls field visibility (Description shown, ContentSource/OnsiteLocation hidden if OrientationProviderType_).
If errors or user messages exist after save, redirect is prevented.
validations: txtComments field is limited to 1000 characters via client-side JavaScript.
OrientationDate is validated; invalid dates show a client-side JavaScript message.
Data source selection is cancelled if UserSession is null.
calculations: Sort and filter query parameters are calculated for page redirects.
StartRow and PageSize adjust paging for bulk edit navigation.
conditions: blnReadOnly toggles editability and disables fields.
EnrollmentID controls which panels/buttons are visible.
ProviderTypeCode with 'OrientationProviderType_' logic toggles field visibility.
system_behavior: Redirect after successful save, cancel, or navigation actions.
GridView binds and displays rows according to filters and paging.
JavaScript variables declared dynamically based on current grid state.
Controls (TextBox, Panel, HiddenField) are dynamically manipulated per row.
Disables calendar controls for read-only state.
exceptions: UserSession is null — data load is cancelled.
Agency field blank — add is not performed.
Grid row not dirty — skip save/update.
Redirect suppressed if error messages present.
content_gaps: UI layout and design details are not included.
Exact error handling and message text is not fully visible.
Underlying implementation of controller.Add/Update and Grid control methods is abstracted/not shown.
Not all possible user permissions or session states are described.
